title: Morphism lift from a constant adic quotient realization isomorphism
statement: Under the hypotheses of the constant quotient realization statement, every realized isomorphism is the image of an algebraic morphism between the two derived coefficient objects.

source.place: Tags 093J and 03Q3, the nonempty-chart stalk detection part

proof.text: Transport the realized isomorphism through the completion quotient and inverse-image/constant-section comparison isomorphisms. Evaluation at the supplied point of the nonempty etale chart identifies the stalk of a constant quotient module with its coefficient module. Transport the resulting coefficient morphism back through the natural comparisons; naturality gives an algebraic morphism whose realization is the given arrow.

lean.statement:
theorem constantAdicQuotientRealization_iso_hom_lift
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (n : ℕ)
    (W : Y.Etale) (_w : W.left)
    (E F : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (AdicCompletion d.ideal A ⧸
      (d.ideal.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A))) ^ (n + 1))))
    (e : (constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d n).obj E ≅
      (constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d n).obj F) :
    ∃ f : E ⟶ F,
      (constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d n).map f = e.hom
